stages.desc: Canonical PUFF-SHROOM: oversized round dome PURPLE cap with irregular dark-violet spots; squat pale cream/light green stalk that is one continuous flared flat base, not shoes. Two friendly dark oval eyes with white highlights on stalk, and short pale-green round trumpet/snouting mouth projecting from FRONT OF STALK pointing RIGHT just below the cap. No extra smile mouth. Cap is bigger than stalk. Correct actual PvZ mushroom anatomy, no leaf pedestal or arms. Idle friendly attentive eyes, walk cap bobs with stalk squish, attack short stalk trumpet compresses then expands strongly then relaxes. Hurt cap tips back; KO cap droops and stalk compresses low, sleep cap droops with eyelids closed. Cheer cap stretches up while base stays mushroom-like.

Canonical FUME-SHROOM from PvZ, distinct upgrade of Puff-shroom. Broad large purple rounded cap with irregular dark-purple spots, PURPLE tubular nozzle protrudes from FRONT OF THE CAP itself pointing RIGHT near cap upper-mid height. Critically the nozzle is attached to CAP, NOT attached to pale stalk. Beneath cap is squat pale cream/light-green cylindrical stalk with one flared continuous ground base, dark oval eyes with strong heavy V-shaped MAD brows, tiny grumpy downturned mouth. Fume looks MAD but cute, not scary; maintain brows throughout idle/walk/attack, sleepy softened angry brows only in KO/sleep. No legs/feet/shoes/arms/leaves. Walking uses stalk squish and cap sway; attack cap inflates slightly, nozzle opens/widens and cap lunges, then recovery; hurt nozzle tilts, KO cap droops with stalk compressed, cheer cap stretches proudly without adding limbs.

Canonical original PvZ1 GLOOM-SHROOM: round squat PURPLE bulbous mushroom DOME BODY with several short open PURPLE VENT TUBES arranged all around its circumference/ring. Narrow pale cream/light-green base strip just visible under dome; DO NOT make a normal big cap on a tall mushroom stalk. Two prominent pale off-white round eyes on upper front looking slightly UPWARD, tiny melancholy downturned purple mouth. Friendly/quiet comic gloom expression, no angry brows. Six or more visible short open dark purple vent mouths around sides/front edge, same ring maintained in every pose. No arms, legs, feet, shoes, leaves or huge single snout. Idle dome gently swells, walk dome/base alternately squishes and leans without feet. Attack windup dome pulls inward, release ALL ATTACHED VENT TUBES open/widen and dome swells, recovery relaxes, no detached cloud. Hurt dome recoils; KO dome sags low, vents droop, closed tired eyes; cheer dome rises and eyes brighten with vents perky; sleep low squashed dome eyes closed. Preserve iconic original game vented dome identity, not a mushroom-shaped robot.
